status: Early planning inventory, superseded for selected sources, sharing and ALL coordinates by scene-manifest.json. Retained for physical-intent rationale only; not a registration source or verification result.
framing: Portrait 390:844, top-aligned with centered horizontal crop. Upper 35–40% holds physical targets and story evidence; lower field remains quiet working area. Targets remain within 320px center crop.
sharedSceneRule: Chapters 22 and 23 may share process-court because evolving machines are represented by movable item artwork. Other scene IDs encode changed physical state or working target.
continuity: Opening, cribbed repair, level fueling, sample loading and cabin views share one staged lander; its upper cabin departs and lower frame remains.

Farm is an opaque imported pressure enclosure under sound basalt. Artificial lamps illuminate three consistent zones: potato left, soybean back, lettuce right/front-right; reservoir below returns, berth behind dry partition. No glass-roof greenhouse.
Same material-processing retort later becomes methane reactor, same solar furnace later cooks. Reflectors remain outdoors.
Original membrane, near-well core and remote layered-ice core remain visually distinct and separately contained.
No future construction painted before creation. Avoid duplicate painted copies of carried machinery; fixed targets can represent previously established equipment in a later chapter.
Multiple workplaces in one chapter need a credible physical boundary or view through a threshold, never unprotected scientific equipment outdoors.
